newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Olivetti H1 revenues fall 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Olivetti H1 revenues fall 10 pct.

text.p: Italian information technology group Olivetti said on Thursday its consolidated revenues for the first half of 1997 stood at 3.1 trillion lire ($1.7 billion), down 10.4 percent on the same period in 1996.

The group said in a statement following a board meeting its total net financing requirement at the end of the first half this year was about 2.5 trillion lire, stable on the 2.455 trillion level at the end of June 1996.

The company said that Rodolfo De Benedetti, son of former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti, had resigned from the board and it added he left the post "consistently with Olivetti's newly acquired status of public company." ($ = 1790 Italian Lire)
